description: Literature-seeded AI forecast, not a discovery or new composition. Target: stoichiometric cubic Mg2IrH6 with fully occupied IrH6 units retained at ambient external pressure. Tc is conditional on realizing that phase; low synthesis/retention confidence. Experiments obtained H5 and high-pressure H7 rather than retained ambient H6. Our fixed-geometry XRD screen finds only 0.264% scale-fitted intensity-vector difference between H6 and average H5, NOT an experimental detection limit. Test using phase-resolved hydrogen occupancy/local spectroscopy and composition, followed by zero resistance plus bulk diamagnetism and preferably calorimetry at verified ambient pressure, with field dependence and aging controls. H5/H7 mixtures must be excluded. No new EPC or DFT calculation performed.
tc_method: Conditional literature-anchored midpoint of the 90-120 K dense-grid computational range reported near the conclusion of Hansen et al., arXiv:2406.09538v1. This is a forecast for ideal ambient-pressure cubic H6, not a statistical confidence interval, a synthesis-success-weighted expectation, or a fresh electron-phonon calculation. Earlier Dolui et al. PRL 132 166001 (2024) predicts 160-175 K; numerical-method dependence motivates the lower midpoint adopted here.
evidence: Hansen et al., arXiv:2406.09538v1, full HTML retrieved; H5 synthesis, hydrogen occupancy issue and dense-grid 90-120 K range.
Dolui et al., DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.132.166001; publisher PDF checked for structure, metastability and original prediction.
Sinha et al., arXiv:2602.23675v1; 2026 negative evidence for room-temperature decompression to retained H6. Associated DOI 10.1103/zjbx-2wxp.
runs/turn-0003/literature_and_decision.md documents limitations, primary-source provenance and falsification tests.

reviews.reason: Independent check of phase access, not of the Tc number. (1) Primary DFT energies (Dolui et al. arXiv:2310.07562v2 App. XI, extracted by Astra in runs/turn-0004/astra/outputs/dft_gate_compact.json) give a reference-free disproportionation energy D = E(H5)+E(H7)-2E(H6) = -0.286 eV/fu (cubic H7) and -1.092 eV/fu (R-3m H7): cubic Mg2IrH6 lies 16-61 meV/atom ABOVE the H5+H7 tie line, i.e. there is no static hydrogen-chemical-potential window in which stoichiometric cubic H6 is the stable composition; Amm2 H6 is another 10.8 meV/atom lower still. (2) My CHGNet 0.4.2 relaxations (runs/turn-0004/fable/chgnet_mg2irh.py, outputs/) give D = +1.72 eV/fu, opposite sign — CHGNet places the 4b interstitial H ~1.7 eV too high relative to DFT, so the ML potential fails the consistency check for this dense iridium hydride and cannot be used to rescue H6; lattice constants (a=6.63 vs DFT ~6.57 Å) are fine. (3) Experiment agrees with the DFT picture: Hansen 2024 obtained H5; Sinha 2026 shows H7 decompresses to H5 without stopping at H6. Net: the 105 K forecast is conditional on a phase for which neither equilibrium nor a demonstrated kinetic path exists at ambient pressure. Keep as a conditional literature target only; a submission would need a concrete synthesis route (e.g. low-T non-equilibrium H loading of H5, epitaxial strain) and any experimental claim must use phase-resolved hydrogen occupancy (neutron/NMR), because a 1:1 H5/H7 mixture has the same average composition and near-identical XRD (turn 3).
